citation.title: Obesity and Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation—An Exploratory Study
citation.journal: Clinical Medicine Insights: Circulatory, Respiratory and Pulmonary Medicine

provenance.quote: Tracheotomized morbidly obese adult subjects (body mass index [BMI] ⩾ 40; age > 18 years)
for non-ARDS hypoxic and/or hypercapnic respiratory failure with need for intubation and mechanical ventilation, with subsequent tracheostomy creation for failure to liberate from the ventilator
The study was conducted in a university teaching hospital with a 9-bed respiratory intermediate unit (RIU).
Subjects randomized to the ESO group had PEEP adjusted to overcome negative Ptp with a goal to maintaining Ptp positive (Ptp 0-5 cmH2O), maintaining as close to zero as possible.
The study outcomes were the percentage of subjects weaned from the ventilator at day 30 and time to wean from the ventilator.
A total of 25 subjects were prospectively enrolled.
Prospectively enrolled morbidly obese subjects admitted from January 2011 through September 2013 were randomized in a simple 1:1 ratio to 1 of 2 protocols for setting PEEP
Obesity and Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation—An Exploratory Study

Pilot study to determine whether morbidly obese adult tracheotomized subjects (body mass index [BMI] ⩾ 40) can be more efficiently weaned from the ventilator by optimizing their positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) using either an esophageal balloon or the best achieved static effective compliance.
due to the nature of our intervention, our study could not be blinded to either the subjects or the therapists
this is a single-center study in an institution with experience in managing morbidly obese subjects

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_subgroup: enrolment required non-ARDS respiratory failure. obesity_subgroup: enrolment required BMI >= 40. timing_subgroup: intervention began at randomization in already-tracheotomized weaning-phase subjects; no interval from intubation/ICU admission/ARDS onset is reported, so coded unclear per codebook ruling. ptp_target_subgroups: end-expiratory Ptp target 0-5 cmH2O using absolute Pes subtraction. Mortality: no mortality reported in this study, so no entry carries is_longest_reported_mortality.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Not listed in any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre (Vidant Medical Center / East Carolina University, Greenville, NC), registration NCT02323009, enrolment January 2011 to September 2013, tracheotomized obese weaning population — no other record in the review shares this registration, centre, or population.
unclear_items: eligibility.criteria.icu_setting: study conducted in a 9-bed respiratory intermediate unit (RIU) rather than an ICU proper, though subjects had recent ICU admission; coded yes, routed for adjudication.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted / n_placement_successful: paper states technical difficulties precluded passing the esophageal balloon or obtaining Cstat measurements in some subjects and 2 subjects were excluded, but does not state how many balloon placements were attempted or failed, nor in which arm(s).
population.n_analysed: derived as 25 - 2 = 23; the paper does not print the analysed total explicitly, and the arm-level split of the 2 excluded subjects is not given (Tables show N=13 and N=12).

outcomes: time-to-wean arm-level data appear in Figure 1's embedded table (mean ± SD and median); the medians with ranges in the text and the means in the figure are both recorded, but the figure is the only source for the means.

feasibility.n_crossover_between_arms and n_lost_to_followup: no values reported; recorded as 0 by inference from a 30-day follow-up with no losses mentioned — flagged for adjudication rather than silently assumed.
design.countries: inferred from the institutional affiliation (Greenville, NC, USA); the paper does not state the country explicitly.
data_only_in_figure: time to wean, mean ± SD per arm (Figure 1 embedded table: ESO 6.25 ± 6.1 days; Cstat 15.1 ± 6.9 days)
Kaplan-Meier time-to-wean curves for the entire cohort (Figure 2)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Population is tracheotomized weaning-phase morbidly obese subjects in a respiratory intermediate unit, not acutely ventilated ICU patients; the balloon remained in place up to 7 days. No mortality, ventilator-free days, or ICU/hospital length-of-stay outcomes are reported. The primary outcome per the statistical analysis section was time to wean. Table 2 also reports End Exp AWP (end-expiratory airway pressure) for the ESO group (13.2 ± 4.7 baseline to 26.8 ± 5.5 post, delta 13.5 ± 6.8, P < .001), which has no dedicated schema field beyond the ventilator_settings entries recorded. The Image 1 caption computes Ptp as 'Paux – Paw' which appears to be a typographical inversion of the methods' Paw − Pes.
